name: Socket Event Hardcode Guard
description: Detect hardcoded socket event strings instead of SOCKET_EVENTS constants

then.prompt: Review the file that was just saved. Check if any socket.on() or socket.emit() calls use hardcoded string literals (e.g., 'zone:enter', 'resource:updated') instead of the SOCKET_EVENTS constants from '@mirage/shared-types'. If violations are found, show the exact lines and the correct SOCKET_EVENTS replacement. Only report if violations exist.
